<script lang="ts">
import type { Variants } from 'motion-v'
import type { IconProps } from '@animate-ui/vue/icons'

export type PhoneCallProps = IconProps<keyof typeof animations>;

export const animations = {
  default: (() => {
    const animation: Record<string, Variants> = {
      phone: {
        initial: { rotate: 0, scale: 1 },
        animate: {
          rotate: [0, -10, 10, -10, 10, 0],
          scale: [1, 0.88, 0.88, 0.88, 0.88, 1],
          transition: { duration: 0.7, ease: 'easeInOut' },
        },
      },
    };

    for (let i = 1; i <= 2; i++) {
      animation[`wave${i}`] = {
        initial: { opacity: 1, scale: 1 },
        animate: {
          opacity: [1, 0.25, 1],
          scale: [1, 0.85, 1],
          transition: {
            duration: 0.5,
            ease: 'easeInOut',
            delay: 0.15 * (i - 1),
          },
        },
      };
    }

    return animation;
  })() satisfies Record<string, Variants>,
  blink: (() => {
    const animation: Record<string, Variants> = {
      phone: {
        initial: { rotate: 0, scale: 1 },
        animate: {
          rotate: [0, -10, 10, -10, 10, 0],
          scale: [1, 0.88, 0.88, 0.88, 0.88, 1],
          transition: { duration: 0.7, ease: 'easeInOut' },
        },
      },
    };

    for (let i = 1; i <= 2; i++) {
      animation[`wave${i}`] = {
        initial: { opacity: 1, scale: 1 },
        animate: {
          opacity: 0,
          scale: 0,
          transition: {
            opacity: {
              duration: 0.2,
              ease: 'easeInOut',
              repeat: 1,
              repeatType: 'reverse',
              repeatDelay: 0.2,
              delay: 0.2 * (i - 1),
            },
            scale: {
              duration: 0.2,
              ease: 'easeInOut',
              repeat: 1,
              repeatType: 'reverse',
              repeatDelay: 0.2,
              delay: 0.2 * (i - 1),
            },
          },
        },
      };
    }

    return animation;
  })() satisfies Record<string, Variants>,
} as const;
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { IconWrapper } from '@animate-ui/vue/icons'
import { motion } from 'motion-v'

defineOptions({ name: 'PhoneCall', inheritAttrs: false })
</script>

<template>
  <IconWrapper
    v-slot="{ variants, controls, size, attrs }"
    :animations="animations"
    v-bind="$attrs"
  >
    <motion.svg
      :width="size"
      :height="size"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      :stroke-width="2"
      stroke-linecap="round"
      stroke-linejoin="round"
      v-bind="attrs"
    >
      <motion.path
        d="M13 6a5 5 0 0 1 5 5"
        :variants="variants.wave1"
        initial="initial"
        :animate="controls"
      />
      <motion.path
        d="M13 2a9 9 0 0 1 9 9"
        :variants="variants.wave2"
        initial="initial"
        :animate="controls"
      />
      <motion.path
        d="M13.832 16.568a1 1 0 0 0 1.213-.303l.355-.465A2 2 0 0 1 17 15h3a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v3a2 2 0 0 1-2 2A18 18 0 0 1 2 4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h3a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v3a2 2 0 0 1-.8 1.6l-.468.351a1 1 0 0 0-.292 1.233 14 14 0 0 0 6.392 6.384"
        :variants="variants.phone"
        initial="initial"
        :animate="controls"
      />
    </motion.svg>
  </IconWrapper>
</template>
